description: If the assigned binary relation \(R\) is a strict linear order on \(M\), the second-order minimum formula is true under full semantics exactly when \(R\) is a well-order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize_wellOrder.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] (R : ℕ) (a : ℕ → M) (r : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment M)
  [IsStrictTotalOrder M fun x y => r 2 R ![x, y]] :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize a r
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.wellOrderFormula R) ↔
    IsWellOrder M fun x y => r 2 R ![x, y]
